declared_at: 2026-10-30, before any model was fitted on the fixed-stride cache
hypothesis: Charge-curve indicators reduce remaining-life error versus the best simple capacity-only baseline on unseen HUST cells when sampling does not depend on the future length of the history.
data: HUST 77 LFP/graphite cells, raw pickles (archive SHA256 pinned in hust.py), physical cycle IDs read from the raw keys

controls.A: adaptive stride ceil(N/600) with capacity + cycle_offset (existing pipeline)
controls.A_no_offset: adaptive stride, capacity only, no cycle_offset channel
controls.B_span_only: adaptive stride, only the window span 7*stride (no capacity, no indicators)

split.scheme: 5-fold grouped by physical cell, each cell tested exactly once
split.per_fold: calibration 12 cells, validation 12 cells, remaining cells train

models: gru_capacity (40 epochs max, early stop on validation)
baseline_choice: best of {linear_window, ridge, gb_capacity} by mean validation macro-MAE over folds, chosen before looking at test errors
metrics: paired cell bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples, seed 7)

go_no_go_provisional.note: Practical thresholds are unknown and need agreement with a user; these values are declared now and are not tuned to results.
go_no_go_provisional.G1_channel: control B macro-MAE / median macro-MAE < 0.8 means the stride channel alone carries material information
go_no_go_provisional.G2_primary: lower bound of the 95% paired-bootstrap interval of (baseline MAE - gb_indicators MAE) on the fixed-stride arm is > 0
go_no_go_provisional.G3_coverage: per-cell mean coverage of the relative split-conformal interval for gb_indicators >= 0.85
go_no_go_provisional.G4_abstention: weighted MAE at 60% accepted windows <= 0.8 x MAE at 100% accepted, ranked by indicator/capacity disagreement

limits: Retrospective laboratory check on one dataset, one charge protocol, discharge protocol groups unmapped; windows within a cell are correlated; seeds are not independent samples; not field validation.
